notes: The opening «ونهى صلى الله عليه وآله عن لبستين» has no transmitter: the Prophet is the speaker of a multi-sentence report with no isnad, so it is not a group.
«قال الأصمعي» is a lexicographer's commentary, not a link.
«وقال الصادق» has no transmitter before him and is a single-link group, as imam_in_text.
